basics.name: externalDomain
basics.label: External domain
basics.toolTip: A domain you control and can create DNS records for, e.g. bdp.yourcompany.com. After deployment you must point a WILDCARD record (*.your-domain) at the ingress load balancer's public IP, which the deployment outputs. The wildcard is required: sign-in is served at keycloak.your-domain and each provisioned tool gets its own subdomain, so a single A record is not enough. No domain to hand? Use <ip-with-dashes>.sslip.io once you have the IP.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a real domain you control, with at least one dot (e.g. bdp.yourcompany.com). Placeholder domains such as example.com will not resolve and the platform will be unreachable.

basics.name: tlsMode
basics.label: HTTPS certificate
basics.defaultValue: Provide my own certificate, or none for now
basics.toolTip: How the platform gets its TLS certificate. Keycloak issues every token, so without one, logins and tokens cross the network in clear text. Let's Encrypt needs the domain to already point at this cluster, which on a new cluster it cannot -- install first, point DNS at the ingress address, then upgrade with this set.

allowedValues.label: Provide my own certificate, or none for now
Request from Let's Encrypt (domain must already resolve to this cluster)

basics.name: adminEmail
basics.label: Administrator email
basics.toolTip: Where certificate expiry warnings are sent. Required by Let's Encrypt.

basics.name: tlsSecretName
basics.label: TLS secret name
basics.toolTip: Kubernetes secret holding the certificate. With Let's Encrypt it is created for you -- name it anything, e.g. bdp-tls. Otherwise create the secret in the release namespace first. Leave blank to serve plain HTTP.

options.text: Storage class applies to NEW installs only — changing it later does not move or resize existing volumes. Sizes set the initial PersistentVolumeClaim capacity; most CSI drivers support online expansion afterwards, but shrinking a volume is not supported.

elements.name: storageClass
elements.label: Storage class
elements.toolTip: The Kubernetes StorageClass used for platform PersistentVolumeClaims (PostgreSQL, Redis, shared data). New-install only. 'Cluster default' uses whatever StorageClass your AKS cluster marks as default.

elements.name: postgresSizeGi
elements.label: PostgreSQL volume size (GiB)
elements.toolTip: Size of the PostgreSQL primary PersistentVolumeClaim, in GiB.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number of GiB between 1 and 9999.

elements.name: redisSizeGi
elements.label: Redis volume size (GiB)
elements.toolTip: Size of the Redis master PersistentVolumeClaim, in GiB.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number of GiB between 1 and 9999.

elements.name: sharedDataSizeGi
elements.label: Shared data volume size (GiB)
elements.toolTip: Size of the shared RWX PersistentVolumeClaim (bdp-shared-data) used for cross-tool drop folders, in GiB.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number of GiB between 1 and 99999.
